experiment: 36G heat_head V2 with direct full dynamic-Z supervision
reason: V1 heat-head training without direct Z loss barely changed overall free_metric and worsened the original five unseen geometries. V2 adds zrel_weight=0.5, keeping all other settings fixed.
decision: reject V2; checkpoint is identical to V5; retain V5
root_cause: V2 zrel loss used GeomFracET zhat, while deployment ignores zhat and computes seawater dynamic impedance from the geometry-conditioned ZFix tangent plus copper-temperature resistance.
next_step: Implement a differentiable training rollout using the same atlas-predicted operators, ZFix tangent, shape_mix, thermal_step and shape_step as geom_free.rollout.
